title: Mark imported emissions-controlled products as the rules require
what: An imported emissions-controlled product that is certified must be marked as the rules require.

sources.title: Product Emissions Standards Act 2017
sources.quote: 14 Import of product that is not marked as required (1) A person contravenes this subsection if: (a) the person imports a product; and (b) the product is an emissions-controlled product that is certified for the purposes of this Act; and (c) the rules impose requirements for marking the product; and (d) the product is not marked in the way required by the rules.
